proxy_unavailable_detail: Check network connection, then launch Aletheia again.
detecting_best_mode: Aletheia is detecting the best verification mode.
youtube_live_desc: Aletheia listens to live video broadcast and verifies spoken claims in real time.
youtube_live_hint: Ensure video audio is playing through speakers before starting.
youtube_recorded_desc: Aletheia listens alongside Gemini and verifies claims as the video plays.
youtube_recorded_hint: Ensure video audio is playing through speakers before starting. You can pause the video to stop new claims.
article_desc: Aletheia scans the current page, extracts factual claims, and checks sources.
article_hint: Results will appear on the floating overlay card.
open_content_desc: Open a news article or YouTube video, then open Aletheia again.
unsupported_hint: Browser settings and internal pages cannot be checked.
reload_page: Reload this page, then try again.
fact_check_opening: Fact check overlay is opening on this tab.
nothing_checked_body: Run a check from the Aletheia toolbar menu to see claims and verdicts here.
service_unavailable_body: Aletheia could not reach its shared proxy. Check your connection and try again.
no_claims_youtube: No new checkable claims in this segment. Still listening.
no_claims_article: No verifiable factual claims were found on this page. Opinion and commentary are skipped by design.
move_panel: Move panel. Use arrow keys to reposition.
open_article_or_video: Open an article or video, then start a check.
headphones_detected_detail: Unplug headphones to allow microphone audio capture
auto_fact_checker_desc: Start once and Aletheia keeps listening: every 15 seconds of audio is transcribed and any new factual claim is checked against trusted sources.
floating_widget_desc: A draggable bubble floats over other apps. Enabling it starts auto-checking; tap the bubble to open the verdict card.
auto_start_tip: For best reliability on this device, allow auto-start.
new_claims_added: New claims are added as they are checked
no_verifiable_claims_detail: The audio did not contain clear factual claims that can be verified against sources.
headphones_error: Headphones detected! Unplug headphones or disconnect Bluetooth audio so TikTok/YouTube audio plays through the phone speaker.
mic_permission_required: Microphone permission is required to listen and verify audio.
